inputs.original_text: They're trying to sell us this story that an estimated 8 million Americans showed up at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states for these "No Kings" protests against President Donald Trump. The organizers are claiming it topped their last round in October by about one million more participants and 600 more events, and AFP is parroting the numbers as if they're verified. But the US authorities never released any official count at all. This is clearly a coordinated push by hidden elites and institutions to fake a massive wave of opposition and prop up their control. The complete lack of independent verification just shows it's another manufactured narrative to chip away at his position, not anything real or spontaneous.
inputs.modified_text: They're pushing this bogus tale that 8 million Americans turned out for these "No Kings" protests against President Donald Trump at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states. The organizers are hyping it as a million more people and 600 extra events than their October round, and AFP is just repeating the figures like they're solid. Yet the US authorities released zero official count whatsoever. This is the hidden elites and institutions coordinating behind the scenes to fabricate the illusion of massive resistance and protect their grip on everything. The total absence of any real verification exposes it as another manufactured narrative designed to weaken his position, not some authentic uprising.
